title: Chipotle-Spiced Chicken Tinga
description: Shredded chicken thighs slow-cooked with black beans, chipotle chilli flakes and tomato purée for a smoky Mexican-style tinga.
ingredients: 6 chicken thigh fillets, excess fat trimmed away
400g (14oz) can of black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Simply place all the ingredients into the slow-cooker pot, season well, mix everything together and cook on high for 3-4 hours, or on low for 6-7 hours.
Once the cooking time is up, use 2 forks to thoroughly shred the chicken, mixing it in to absorb the sauce as you go.
notes: Serve over tostadas with shredded lettuce, chopped avocado and tomatoes, jalapeños, grated cheese and lime wedges. Quick Purple Pickle (p.210) goes really well with this. Oven method: 180°C/160°C fan, Gas Mark 4 — double stock to 300ml, cook in casserole with lid for 1 hour 20 minutes.
